caption: Møns Klint, Borre
composition: White chalk cliffs and the Baltic from the cliff-top path · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the cliff-top path, the white chalk face of Møns Klint drops to a narrow beach and the Baltic, with beech trees along the edge. Leaves are still mostly green in late September, with only a little early yellow. The night is clear, about 12.7°C, and the chalk takes the moonlight. The portrait includes the wooden stair that visitors use on this cliff; the wide frame is the cliff line itself.
